edit.text: Banshee leads the X-Men to Cassidy Keep to free Lilandra from Juggernaut and Sean's brother Tom.

Robert Gonzales serves S.H.I.E.L.D. under Director Fury and commands the Iliad when Hydra rises. When Bobbi reveals Fury's order to sink the ship, Gonzales insists they follow it until Bobbi and Mack push to retake it. He later admits that following it would have killed hundreds of agents.
edit.whoA: The Iliad's commander, who insists on following Fury's order to sink it.
edit.whoB: Gonzales's old director, whose order to sink the Iliad he insists on following.

edit.text: Diamondback is the arms dealer who supplies Cottonmouth's guns, and Cottonmouth calls himself his number one seller.

add.text: After Cottonmouth's death, Diamondback calls him his friend and his number one seller, and says he gave him the Biggie photo in his office. He takes over the office and moves in on Cottonmouth's empire.
